item.title: 'What did the poor dog do?' Rahul comes in support of Renuka over canine row
item.description: What did the poor dog do? Are they not allowed here?” When informed by accompanying officials that pets are not allowed in the complex, he said, “Pets are allowed inside,” pointing towards the Parliament.

item.title: Woman Dies After Being Hit by Bullet Bike in Pedda Shapur
item.description: A tragic Pedda Shapur Tanda road accident in Ranga Reddy district claimed the life of a 35-year-old woman after a Bullet bike hit her while she was crossing the highway.

item.title: Pakistan reports big rise in gender-based violence against women
item.description: Pakistan has reported a big rise in crimes against women during the first 11 months of 2025, Sahil, an organisation monitoring gender-based violence, said in a report which has been highlighted by the local media on Tuesday.

item.title: Hyderabad, Bomb Threat Email Creates Panic Again at RGIA Airport
item.description: A fresh bomb threat email targeting Indigo flight 6E1234 created panic at Shamshabad's RGIA Airport. The flight was diverted to Mumbai for safety checks. Full details here.

item.title: India never provokes, but do not leave evil doers: Rajnath Singh
item.description: Sending a strong message to its western neighbour, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh said on Tuesday that India is a peace-loving nation and does not provoke anyone but is prepared to eliminate anyone who disturbs peace and harmony in the country.

item.title: Tejashwi Yadav congratulates Prem Kumar for being elected as Speaker of Bihar Assembly
item.description: Following the unanimous election of BJP leader and Gaya Sadar MLA Prem Kumar as the Speaker of the Bihar Legislative Assembly, Leader of the Opposition Tejashwi Yadav extended his congratulations and highlighted the importance of maintaining the dignity of parliamentary democracy.

item.title: Parakamani theft case: SIT submits report to Andhra Pradesh High Court
item.description: The Special Investigation Team (SIT), which probed the Parakamani theft case at Sri Venkateswara Swamy temple, Tirumala, submitted its report to the Andhra Pradesh High Court on Tuesday.

item.title: 231 crore Aadhaar authentication transactions in Nov, e-KYC jumps over 24 pc
item.description: The government on Tuesday said that Aadhaar authentication transactions saw 8.47 per cent growth (year-on-year) at 231 crores in the month of November.

item.title: Assam: PM Modi reiterates commitment on Asom Diwas
item.description: Extending greetings on the occasion of Asom Divas, Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Tuesday reiterated the commitment to advancing the inclusive, culturally rooted and development-oriented vision of Swargadeo Chaolung Sukapha, the founder of the Ahom kingdom, whose legacy continues to shape Assam’s identity.

item.title: Future Kids School Dominates Secunderabad Basketball Club League 2025, Wins Both Boys & Girls Titles
item.description: Future Kids School emerged as the undisputed champion in both the boys’ and girls’ categories at the Secunderabad Basketball Club League 2025 (U-14), held at Secunderabad Club from October 20 to December 1, 2025.
